title: Printable Baby Milestone Cards, 16 Pastel Monthly Cards, Newborn to One Year, First Christmas Card, 5x7 Digital Download
description:
16 calm, pastel milestone cards for photos from day one to the first birthday.

What you get:
- hello little one, 1 to 11 months, one whole year, first Christmas, first smile, first steps
- 3 PDFs: single 5x7 in pages, 2 per US Letter page, 2 per A4 page (with cut lines)
- 16 high-resolution 5x7 JPGs (300 dpi)

This is a digital download. No physical item is shipped. Print at home, at a local print shop or online. Colours vary a little by screen and printer. For personal use only; please don't resell or share the files.

About the art: designed by Littlefold, a Steadfold studio. The illustrations were drawn with the help of AI (AI-written vector code), then chosen, coloured and finished by us.
